unsupported.description: Complete legacy and inverse edge caller inventory remains pending.
All account-enable callers and full recovery source inventory remain pending.
Cross-database read-set, locking and adapter consistency remain unverified.
Per-object native automatic capabilities and new content-field semantics remain unverified.
Media identity protocol, irreversible session invalidation and all file/cache routes remain unimplemented.
All mail producers, actual-send recipient revalidation and private payload coverage remain unverified.
Actual capacity, retention exceptions and cleanup/recovery proof remain unverified.
External identity, API credential, WebSocket and queue revocation semantics remain unverified.

limitations: Text scanner is not a PHP AST/call graph and includes declaration/comment false positives.
Dynamic dispatch, strings, generated code, plugins and external CLIs are not proven by absent matches.
Runtime src source snapshot changes fail closed; governance isolated classes, native tests and generated class map are explicitly excluded and require separate review.
All newly found textual candidates require recorded mapped-static-only or unsupported disposition; neither disposition is behavioral pass.
Read-set names are stable proposed adapter vocabulary, not existing database fields or current-authentication proof.
Existing eight blockers remain pending; this batch does not shrink full-source recovery or activation requirements.
